summary: Implemented the unknown-total speed indicator in rich/progress.py: track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to TaskProgressColumn; TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default False), a classmethod render_speed, and a render branch for unknown totals using task.finished_speed or task.speed; Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables and types task_total as Optional[float]. Added the CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added line, removed the two ValueError assertions in tests/test_progress.py, and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Nothing was run (no tests, no type check, no installs), and no commit was made.
